title: Best robot vacuum deal: Roborock’s flagship Saros Z70 hit 50% off on Amazon
excerpt: Let your floors clean themselves with this massive half-off discount.
content_html:
SAVE $1,000: As of Sept. 22, the Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum and Mop is down to $999.98 at Amazon. That’s a 50% discount and a match for its lowest-ever price.

Credit: Roborock

$999.99 at Amazon
$1,999.99 Save $1,000

Keeping your floors spotless usually means spending hours behind a traditional vacuum or dropping a small fortune on a high-end robot cleaner. But when a flagship model drops down to half price, the decision gets a lot easier.

As of Sept. 22, Amazon has chopped $1,000 off the Roborock Saros Z70 Robot Vacuum and Mop, bringing it down to $999.98. That markdown brings this ultra-premium, feature-packed automated cleaner back down to its best price on record.

When Mashable reviewer Leah Stodart tested the Z70 hands-on, she found the arm could be a bit slow — struggling with heavier shoes or unfamiliar fabrics — but it consistently cleared away everyday clutter like socks and lightweight footwear before making its cleaning pass. Even if you ignore the arm entirely, the cleaning hardware hits monster specs. You're getting 22,000Pa of suction power, which easily pulls deep-seated pet hair and dust out of plush carpets.

Despite holding a mechanical arm and a high-powered motor, the Z70 maintains an ultra-slim 3.14-inch profile that slides under low-clearance couches and TV stands without getting wedged. For hard floors, it uses dual spinning mop pads that swing out on a motorized hinge to scrub along baseboards and corners, and is backed by an automatically heated water tank to break down dried spills.

When it's done, it navigates back to a fully automated dock that washes the mops with 176°F hot water, dries them with warm air, dispenses its own cleaning solution, and empties its own dustbin for up to seven weeks of hands-off maintenance. In our review, the Saros Z70 lost points solely due to its massive price tag. At $1,000 off, those minor quirks are a lot easier to forgive.
